quotations.old_english: He ða gesceafta nú gebridlod [MS. gebridlode] hæfþ
quotations.english: he has now bridled the creatures

quotations.old_english: Ðæt hí hira mód gebridligen that they bridle their mind

source_text: ge-bridlian, -bridligan; p. ode; pp. od [ge-, bridlian to bridle] To bridle, restrain; fr&e-long;n&a-long;re :-- He ða gesceafta nú gebridlod [MS. gebridlode] hæfþ he has now bridled the creatures, Bt. 21; Fox 74, 32. Ðæt hí hira mód gebridligen that they bridle their mind, Past. 33, 1; Swt. 215, 7; Hat. MS. 41 a, 8.
